lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Leviathan poses a serious threat.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: That black goo she manipulates is most likely some kind of liquid metal.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: It's the only thing that would explain its density and durability.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: When connected with other pools, it can be used as a passageway, and it can be compressed into a sphere to subdue the enemy.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: It can also be molded into a tidal wave-like formation. Needless to say, it's a highly versatile weapon.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: All-purpose, almost.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: But according to the combat data, it wasn't used for many actual attacks.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: It uses its own mass to physically strike, but it doesn't appear to have any other lethal capabilities.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Its speed is also on the slow side, so there is a limit to its lethality.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Right. Therefore, the key is to figure out how much of that black liquid there is.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: It was spread throughout the area. Considering how much Leviathan has moved around, there must be a significant amount of it underground.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: If only I could figure out its composition, I might be able to eradicate it. So frustrating.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: It's unfortunate, but we came here to take down Behemoth.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Exactly. There have been a lot of unexpected developments, so we shouldn't be too hard on ourselves.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: We continue to focus on eliminating Behemoth.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: So... what do we do about Leviathan?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: We'll have to leave that to Cinderella and Grave.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: For now, it's our only option.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Helloooooo? Are we invisible or something?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You all will act as support. Stick close and provide assistance when we request it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Don't chase after glory heedlessly like fools.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Tsk.
*Whip*
Eunhwa tosses Rapi a USB.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: That contains the tactical upgrade OS prepared by Ingrid.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Take a look. If you like what you see, you could put in a request for some modifications.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Customized modifications?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Correct. When we first planned this series of upgrades, we included you as well.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Not sure what you'll think of it though.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Hmph.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Also, I don't want to hear anything from you about us not going far enough.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You worry about yourself.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: If there's anyone here who stopped short, it was you when you chose to leave.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... Right. Thanks.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Picking up anything from Cinderella or Grave?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Yeah, both of them. Up ahead.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I set up the tracking devices to detect their signals ahead of time.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Nicely done.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Can you use that to detect the Heretics?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Forget tracking. This device doesn't even recognize Behemoth or Leviathan.
Shifty said something similar earlier.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: It's highly likely that they possess stealth capabilities of their own.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: It could be another function of the Dark Matter they're coated in.
If they're trying to hide, could it be that they're afraid?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Huh? What do you mean?
I explain the dynamics between the Four Beasts and the other Heretics.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: So there are different factions amongst the Heretics.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: And the Four Beasts have an inferiority complex when being stacked up against the Offsprings, as they call them.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: This is huge.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: If we play our cards right, we could encourage some infighting between them.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Of course, that's only if they're interested in talking with us.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I-I don't like that idea very much.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I'd rather kill them outright and be done with it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Agreed. There's no point in conversing with monsters.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: We're nearly there.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: ... Something's a little weird, though.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: They've barely moved

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: from their previous positions a while back.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Could they be injured?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I highly doubt that.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... True.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Let's move quickly.
*Splash*
For a moment, we can hear the sound of water splashing.
It stops, but a few moments later...
*Splash*
We can hear it again.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Uh... Guys, am I imagining things?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: No, I see it too. We all do.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... What is this?
Ahead of us, Cinderella is standing.
Next to her, Grave is pouring a bucket of water over her.
*Splash*

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: It's almost all washed away.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: All right. Just a little more, please.
*Splash*

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Is she... taking a shower?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Seems like it.
*Splash*
... Cinderella is washing the black liquid off her body.
Grave, like a faithful attendant, pours water at regular intervals on certain spots of Cinderella's body.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Prince? Is that you?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Wait a moment.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I got all soiled, so let me wash up quickly and join you in a second.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: In the meantime, don't come near.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I don't want you seeing me so filthy.
*Splash*

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: *Sigh*...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What a bunch of weirdoes.
10 minutes later.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Ahhh, so refreshing.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Would you like me to do the same for you, Grave?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: You being beautiful is enough.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Hehe, I'm glad you think so.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Would any of you like to clean up?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: There's no more water.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I see some right beside you!

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: That's not for you. That's for Cinderella to use.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: If you want to shower, fetch some water yourself. There's a water tank over there.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Pssh... you're just a glorified shower faucet...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Does anyone have a hair dryer?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Why in the world would any of us have...

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I have one. Just a moment.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I knew I could count on you, Grave.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... I can't believe this.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Enough.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: We're in the middle of a mission. There is no time for R&R.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: This isn't R&R. This is something that must be done.
Cinderella saunters over and stands before the members of Absolute.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Wow... you look great.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Yeah, so pretty.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I presume you're the Absolute Squad?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Grave told me all about you.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It's because of you that I was able to awaken. You have my thanks.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Especially the little one over there.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: M-me?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You never lost the will to fight, even when your body was on the verge of breaking down.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Very beautiful.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Hehehe... I-it was nothing.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You mustn't be so modest.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You must have more confidence. You were amazing.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Er... Okay!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: And you, the one with the nice fragrance.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Are you talking about me?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You have a potent fragrance, but it puts me at ease.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Could you tell me what scent it is that you're wearing?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh my... Sure!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I didn't buy it. I mixed it myself.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Would you like to know the recipe?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'd love to.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe, I never thought I'd meet someone who I could talk to about perfumes.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: And you, the one with the intense gaze.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I hear you're the leader.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Brilliant. Despite not wearing any advanced equipment, you demonstrated superlative combat skills and teamwork.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Instead of relying on your superior physical specifications, you devoted yourself entirely to employing human fighting tactics.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Such an unshakeable belief in yourself.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Such wondrous beauty.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Hmph. You've got a good eye.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Jeez, everyone is like putty in her hands.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: She certainly has a way of ingratiating herself with people.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Well, now that we're all in one spot,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: what is the plan, Prince?
We're going to hunt down Behemoth and Leviathan.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: How do you intend to go about that?
Rapi, you explain.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... Okay.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Behemoth far surpasses us in terms of physical capabilities.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Fighting her head-on would be inadvisable, save perhaps for Cinderella.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: However, Absolute has undergone a series of upgrades in preparation for a fight against her.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: As for Leviathan, her physical strength is weaker in comparison.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: The fact that she evaded all gunfire by stepping into the puddles is a sign of that.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: However, that black liquid of hers is highly unpredictable, and we can't accurately estimate the extent of its power.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Having said that, it's nothing that Cinderella shouldn't be able to overcome.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: In other words, Cinderella will focus on either Behemoth or Leviathan,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: and the Counters and Absolute will deal with the remaining Heretic.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Ideally, Cinderella would be taking on Leviathan.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Wait. There is a flaw in that plan.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: The simplest solution to this problem is my taking them both out in one fell swoop.
They won't let that happen.
They experienced your power firsthand, so they won't attack you both at once.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Are you saying that they are scared?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Heretics? Scared? I find that hard to believe.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: These are the Four Beasts we're talking about. Running scared and hiding has been their M.O. this entire time.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Fair enough.
The Four Beasts will likely try to separate us from Cinderella and eliminate us that way.
They'll then team up and focus the full brunt of their attack on Cinderella.
Of course, it's highly dubious that they'll go about this in a straightforward manner.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: So you're saying there's a high possibility that they'll resort to some underhanded trickery.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You say trickery, I say strategy.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Right. Strategy.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Oh? You're agreeing with me? Seems like I've finally gotten through that thick skull of yours.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: If I didn't agree, you'd never shut up.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: So I agree.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Wowee, Eunhwa's shaking all over!
So, what we need to do
is split them up before they do the same to us.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: All right, Leviathan is mine.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'll leave Behemoth to you guys.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Consider it a gift, Rapi.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Give it your all. Let your spirit soar.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... I will. Thanks.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Wait. There's still one more thing we haven't covered.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: They can still transform as a last resort.
I don't believe the Four Beasts are capable of that.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What makes you so sure?
If they could, they would have done it already.
They were at death's door going up against Cinderella, but they didn't transform.
It's not as if transforming would hurt them in any way. At least it didn't when Nihilister did it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You're right. It was the same with Indivilia.
If it's such a critical skill, the reason why they haven't played that card yet is obvious to me.
They're incapable of it.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: A reasonable assumption.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Perhaps this may have something to do with how they're not highly regarded by the other Heretics.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Hold on, does that mean Cinderella can transform?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I can, although I've never tried.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Why do you think?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Because it wouldn't be beautiful?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: All right, assuming that the probability of the Four Beasts transforming is low, the only issue then is...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: How do we find them?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: We have no way of tracking those two down.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Maybe we wait for them to come to us?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: No. We can't let them make the first move without us first formulating a counterattack.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: If I'm here, won't they steer clear of us?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: That's a good point. They do seem rather wary of you.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: They're probably thinking that if they can take you out, they'll be able to win.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: That's true. If I were to fall, all hope would be lost, as I am the strongest amongst us.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I agree.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Therefore, we can't sit back and wait for them to take you out.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: We need to track them down by any means necessary and make the first move.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Very well, I'll conduct some aerial reconnaissance
I don't think that's a good idea.
You up in the air, exposed and alone? That could be just the opportunity they're waiting for.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Hmm... this is most frustrating.
What about the furthest place possible from where the last encounter was?
Or the area with the greatest density of crystals?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Good call.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: The Four Beasts are going to be conservative with their actions.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: There was a place that I noticed before when I was in the air.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It has a staggering amount of crystals.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I only saw it from a distance, however, so I don't know the way there.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: If you give me the general direction, I can go look.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Oh, right. You've been here for ages.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You're incredible, Grave.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: ... Let's move.
